text:
jess: quick heads-up — we've got two customers that unexpectedly hit shared pools even though they have private VPC endpoints. observed during a canary: requests had X-VPC-ID but no workspace binding in our cache :grimacing:
kevin: ugh. do we have a reproducible trace? logs/trace id?
jess: trace 0f3a1c — sent to #infra and pasted the mini dump. router matched on workspace header fallback to 'global' pool because workspace lookup timed out (30ms).
sam: timeout should not flip isolation. we intentionally kept the header hint as lower priority. is redis flakey?
emily: correct — current precedence is: explicit pool header -> workspace binding -> vpc hint -> tenant fallback. that ordering was chosen to avoid header spoofing.
maria: but for private endpoints we should prefer VPC-bound pools over header hints or fallback. otherwise customers with VPC can get mixed traffic.
kevin: agreed. proposal: promote VPC binding above workspace hint, but keep workspace binding higher than arbitrary header. also stricter validation for X-Workspace-ID (signed nonce).
jess: +1 on validation. we already sign workspace IDs in the console, but gateway doesn't verify signatures today. verifying adds ~2ms. acceptable?
sam: 2ms looks fine, but need a kill-switch for perf-sensitive routes. maybe validate async for streaming responses?
infra-bot: NOTE: current routing rule in prod (pseudocode):
```
if (pool_header) -> route_to_pool
else if (workspace_bound(pool)) -> route_to_workspace_pool
else if (vpc_hint) -> route_to_vpc_pool
else -> global_pool
```
kevin: that pseudocode is what caused the hole. new order proposal:
```
if (pool_header && header_verified) -> route_to_pool
else if (vpc_bound(workspace_or_token)) -> route_to_vpc_pool
else if (workspace_bound(pool)) -> route_to_workspace_pool
else -> global_pool
```
emily: ops implications: we'll need migration to backfill vpc->workspace mappings and a compatibility flag for older private endpoints. also console should show when a request fell back.
maria: telemetry ask: add metric `routing.fallback.vpc_miss` and tag by tenant and region. need per-tenant alert when >0.1% fallback rate.
qa-bot: test matrix ideas: (1) signed/unsigned workspace header (2) vpc header present but workspace cached missing (3) pool header spoof attempts. can add integration tests using endpoint simulator.
jess: rollout plan: feature-flag gating + 2-day shadow mode where new ordering is evaluated but not enforced. collect regressions and perf deltas. then gradual flip with canary groups.
kevin: also update docs for SDKs — warn about header spoofing and mention signature helper in console SDK.
deploy-bot: created RFC ticket INF-4721 and feature flag `vpc_routing_precedence`. staging rollout scheduled 2026-04-01.
sam: one more: how do we present this in the console? propose a per-request banner when a request used a fallback pool: "Routed to shared pool due to workspace lookup timeout" and link to troubleshooting.
emily: UX ok. but must not expose internals to customers. craft friendly message.
maria: I'll own telemetry dashboard and alert rules. jess/sam can you add the integration tests?
jess: yup — starting on tests now. will post a short PR linking test vectors. thanks all :thumbsup:
